title: Freedom Yield Metal — Operator Identity Manifest v1
description: Formal contract for /api/identity.json. The runtime manifest is generated and signed by scripts/operator-local/gen-identity.sh on the operator's local Mac, NEVER on the validator host or web host. Verification uses ssh-keygen -Y verify with namespace freedom-yield/validator-identity. Companion docs: docs/IDENTITY_VERIFICATION.md. This schema is the authoritative shape v1; breaking changes require a new major version at /api/identity.schema.v2.json. The v1 URL stays reachable for at least 18 months after v2 publication.

node_id_authority.description: Authoritative explorer URL where the NodeID's registration can be cross-checked.

site.description: Canonical site URL the operator controls.

operator_identity_pubkey_url.description: URL where the operator identity ed25519 public key is published (typically /.well-known/operator-identity.pub).

operator_identity_pubkey_fingerprint.description: OpenSSH SHA-256 fingerprint of the operator identity public key, e.g., 'SHA256:abc123…'. A consumer can compute the same fingerprint via 'ssh-keygen -l -f operator-identity.pub' and compare.

key_iat.description: When this operator identity key was issued (became authoritative).

key_exp.description: Recommended expiry; operator-declared, NOT cryptographically enforced. Consumers may treat as policy.

revoked.description: true iff this key is no longer authoritative for the brand+node_id. When true, revoked_at + revocation_reason SHOULD be populated.

artifact_manifest.description: Merkle DAG hub: each entry binds a leaf artifact's URL to its content sha256, and (where applicable) its schema URL and schema sha256. A consumer fetches each entry's url, computes sha256(content), and compares to entry.sha256. Additive: new artifacts may appear in this map within v1.

sha256.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 of the artifact's raw bytes as published.

artifact_root.description: SHA-256 Merkle root computed over artifact_manifest entries: leaves are each entry.sha256, ordered alphabetically by key, odd counts duplicate the last leaf, parents are SHA-256(left || right) as raw bytes, hex-encoded at the root. In identity.example.json this field is set to all-zeros (sixty-four '0' characters) to indicate the schema-only preview state; the production runtime identity.json carries the real 64-hex Merkle root after gen-identity.sh computes it from the live artifact bytes.

chain_anchor.description: Reference to the on-chain anchor that binds this manifest's identity key to the validator's NodeID. Populated when the operator has embedded the identity public-key fingerprint in an AddPermissionlessValidatorTx memo (see Phase 6 in project_merkle_dag_identity_anchor_design memory). In identity.example.json the tx_id field is set to all-zeros (sixty-four '0' characters) to indicate that no chain anchor has been embedded yet; production runtime identity.json carries the real 64-hex transaction ID of the cycle whose AddValidator tx carries the fingerprint in its memo. A consumer that sees the placeholder should treat chain_anchor as 'not yet bound' and trust the manifest only at the off-chain layer (ssh-keygen -Y verify level).

tx_id.description: P-Chain transaction ID (64-hex) of the AddValidator tx whose memo carries the identity fingerprint. All-zeros in the schema example = placeholder pending Phase 6 embed.
